sens_en: to judge, to decide, to sentence
origine_fr: La moitié 半 et le couteau 刂 : partager, couper en deux. 半 (bàn) donnait autrefois le son, mais plus celui de pàn. Trancher entre deux parts, c'est juger : 判 veut dire « juger, trancher ».
origine_en: Half 半 and a knife 刂: to divide, to cut in two. 半 (bàn) once gave the sound, but no longer that of pàn. Deciding between two parts is judging: 判 means “to judge, to decide”.

phrase.en: You have to judge for yourself.
